scope: AI assistant protocol and chat data layer; mobile authorization, secure persistence, controller and UI are not implemented in this increment

source.evidence: Anonymous public source and cached runtime configuration only; no actual auth/chat/quota/personal endpoint call

configuration.resolution: Explicit operation reads fixed public runtime JSON assignment; no JavaScript evaluation, redirects, or automatic network on construction
configuration.key_policy: Extract public anonymous key into memory only; validate anon role and matching ref, reject service_role. No real key stored in source, fixtures, logs or this document
configuration.limits: Runtime 65536 bytes/characters, generic JSON 262144 bytes, safe error JSON 65536 bytes, default request20s
configuration.trust: TLS and fixed origins; decoding anonymous key metadata is not cryptographic verification of a user session

wallet_auth_next_increment.nonce: POST /functions/v1/auth-nonce; body address,chain=evm,domain,uri,optional chainId; response message,nonce
wallet_auth_next_increment.signing: Existing connected EOA or existing Privy wallet personal_sign over exact returned message; no replacement wallet
wallet_auth_next_increment.binding: Source uses vanta.wallet_bindings filtered by user_id, matching normalized address and nonempty verified_at
wallet_auth_next_increment.warning: Challenge grammar, actual mobile relying-party behavior and live acceptance remain unverified. Do not substitute Privy token or infer authentication from locally decoded JWT claims

body.request_id: One caller-generated UUID per user turn

chat.context: Oldest messages removed until total content <=12000 UTF16 characters; newest user turn retained and limited to12000. Only nonempty complete user/assistant content sent; no reasoning, display status, local IDs, balances, orders or wallet credentials attached
chat.stream: UTF8 SSE multiline data, CR/LF across chunks, choices[0].delta.content and reasoning_content/thinking_delta; stop/end_turn/[DONE] terminal; length truncated
chat.bounds: 65536 characters per line/frame,2MiB total SSE,131072 combined answer/reasoning characters;300s total,120s idle
chat.fallback: Interrupted, truncated, empty or eligible failed stream may use stream=false with same user/context/request_id. Reasoning-only completion gets one final-answer-only system instruction retry with that same ID
chat.stop: Shared operation cancellation aborts pending headers/body/completion, retains partial content as interrupted, and never starts another fallback. Service disposal aborts all active requests. Repository disposal/finalization cancels operation token
chat.errors: 401/403 require authorization;429/daily_quota_exceeded supplies optional validated limit/used/remaining/reset_at; no raw server diagnostics exposed. Client4xx never triggers completion fallback
chat.quota: No verified remaining count is fabricated from browser default5; source separately reads vanta.ai_daily_usage request_count for current user_id/UTC usage_date. Quota controller/UI remain pending
chat.acceptance: Same request_id fallback matches source but backend deduplication and quota charging have not been live-tested

remaining: Explicit wallet challenge review/validation, exact current-wallet signing, server-confirmed user and verified wallet binding
